scoring_policy.name: Utterances retain fillers and repetitions; word metrics exclude listed fillers
scoring_policy.automatic_boundary_rule: Sentence boundaries with guarded coordinate clauses requiring their own subject; subordinate clauses and coordinated phrases stay attached
scoring_policy.fillers: uh, um, uhm, hmm, hm, mm, mhm, huh, oh and spelling variants removed only for word metrics; all retained for total utterances
scoring_policy.repetition: Retain all transcript repetitions; do not infer or remove stutters or retraces
scoring_policy.limitations: Predicted boundaries and surface words only; no clinical certification, audio review or morphology

scope: Uncorrected ASR transcripts with automatic utterance segmentation
